history.summary: Replaced generated/logged bootstrap passwords with an authoritative mounted FILE and validated ENV fallback, made fresh creation hash-before-insert and historical empty-hash recovery one-time, preserved forced reset and API-token behavior, removed Ansible log scraping, and added focused Go, native logging, container, operations, and self-review coverage. Full verification, race, real Docker lifecycle, dependency checks, and security scanners completed with no new finding.

All acceptance criteria verified: FILE > ENV precedence with fatal authoritative failures, bounded file read with UTF-8/NUL validation, fresh-install atomicity via hash-before-insert, historical empty-hash recovery exactly once, PasswordChangeRequired preserved, Ansible updated with no_log and 0400 file, comprehensive test coverage including container integration, zero plaintext logging.
An empty role variable in vars/main.yml overrides inventory/Vault input, preventing Ansible from provisioning the bootstrap secret.

Moved the empty bootstrap value from high-precedence role vars to role defaults so inventory, play, and Vault overrides reach the protected input-file and systemd tasks; retained no_log, service-user ownership, mode 0400, and safe unset behavior; added an executable structural regression to the full verification gate. Full repository/race, real container lifecycle, YAML parsing, dependency, and security checks preserve all iteration-1 guarantees.

Ansible precedence correction verified: empty default moved to role defaults (low precedence) allowing inventory/play/Vault overrides; structural test proves override reaches secret-file provisioning and service environment; no_log retained on both tasks; file mode 0400 and service-user ownership correct; guard conditions prevent provisioning when unset; all iteration-1 guarantees preserved with zero product code changes; YAML syntax validated.
